description: Scaffold a new IterxAI hardware project (iterx.json, selection, netlist, src/main.ino, sim smoke scenario) plus agent config files. Use when the user has no project yet.

board.description: Board id or alias, e.g. uno, esp32-devkit, esp32-s3, esp32-c3 (see get_rules topic "firmware"). Default arduino-uno.

dir.description: New project directory (absolute, or relative to the server cwd).

dryRun.description: Only report the files that would be written.

harness.description: Comma-separated agents to configure: codex,claude,trae,workbuddy (default all).

name: create_project
